notes: «وكان، محمد بن جبير بن مطعم ذكر لي ذكرا من حديثه» : Muhammad b. Jubayr is the one who first told Ibn Shihab part of the story, not a link of this chain
Malik speaks in the story («فقال مالك انطلقت حتى أدخل على عمر») and is the last link; Umar and Ali and Abbas speak inside the scene, and they are not written as links
